Last updated: 2026-08-19

## Stability Tiers

| Tier | Meaning | Criteria |
|------|---------|----------|
| **Stable** | Rarely changes, well-tested, low bug rate | < 5 commits in 90 days, no open bugs |
| **Evolving** | Active development, reasonable test coverage | 5-20 commits in 90 days, tests exist |
| **Volatile** | Frequent changes, bug-prone, under-tested | > 20 commits in 90 days, or recent bugs |
| **Unknown** | No data, never analyzed | New code, or never touched by AI |
